verdict.rationale: Zep's docs state a concrete latency target: "sub-200ms context retrieval regardless of graph size or number of graphs" on the performance page, repeated in the quick start. But this is a headline marketing figure, not percentile-based numbers or published measurements that back the claim, and nothing independent corroborates it. Missing for 10: p50/p95/p99 percentile figures, a published benchmark methodology or measured results, test conditions (graph size, load, region), independent or hands-on latency corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented retrieval-latency targets or measured numbers (e.g. p50/p95) backing the product's speed claims
